scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow" -n "SERVER,CLIENT,BOT-SRV,BOT-CLI" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:bot-server" "npm run dev:bot-client"
scripts.build:management: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w management-server && npm run build -w management-client
scripts.build:all: npm run build:management && npm run build:bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @timesheet/shared && npm run typecheck -w management-server && npm run typecheck -w management-client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w management-server; npm run lint -w management-client
scripts.coverage:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('.nyc_output', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: npm run coverage:clean && npm run test:e2e && npm run coverage:report
